description: This file defines the SharedHealthCheckManager class which manages distributed health checks across multiple pods using Redis for coordination, caching results, and locking.

classes.name: SharedHealthCheckManager
classes.description: A manager class for coordinating distributed health checks among pods via Redis, implementing caching, locking, and status reporting.

methods.name: __init__( self, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, health_check_ttl: int = DEFAULT_SHARED_HEALTH_CHECK_TTL, lock_ttl: int = DEFAULT_SHARED_HEALTH_CHECK_LOCK_TTL, )
methods.description: Initializes the SharedHealthCheckManager with optional Redis cache and TTL configurations.

methods.name: str get_health_check_lock_key()
methods.description: Returns the Redis key used for the global health check lock.

methods.name: str get_health_check_cache_key()
methods.description: Returns the Redis key used for caching health check results.

methods.name: str get_model_health_check_lock_key(model_name: str)
methods.description: Returns Redis key for model-specific health check lock, given a model name.

methods.name: str get_model_health_check_cache_key(model_name: str)
methods.description: Returns Redis key for model-specific health check cache, given a model name.

methods.name: bool acquire_health_check_lock(self)
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a distributed lock in Redis to perform health checks exclusively.

methods.name: None release_health_check_lock(self)
methods.description: Releases the distributed health check lock in Redis if owned.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_cached_health_check_results(self)
methods.description: Retrieves cached health check results from Redis if available and valid.

methods.name: None cache_health_check_results( self, healthy_endpoints: List[Dict[str, Any]], unhealthy_endpoints: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Stores health check results in Redis with current timestamp.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],List[Dict[str,Any]]] perform_shared_health_check( self, model_list: List[Dict[str, Any]], details: bool = True )
methods.description: Coordinates health checks with cache and locking, performs health check if necessary, and returns healthy/unhealthy endpoints.

methods.name: bool is_health_check_in_progress(self)
methods.description: Checks if a health check is currently ongoing by another pod.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_health_check_status(self)
methods.description: Provides current status info about health check coordination, including lock and cache states.
